progression.narrative: The performance opens on A4 and dwells most on A in Mehdi Zarrabi. The line peaks at C#5 (570.5 Hz) at 0:54.4. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (C#5 → A4 → Gs4 → A4 → Ck5 → F#4).
